observations: Photo 0 shows a large, black and grey printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
The front of the printer features a large label with images of printed documents and a 'hp' logo.
The printer is sitting on a wooden stand in an outdoor or warehouse-like environment.
A watermark 'AC VANG TECHNICS' is visible across the center of the image.
The actual brand name and model number on the device are not legible in the photo.

claims.claim: HP Color LaserJet Enterprise CP4525 Printer series
claims.evidence: The label in photo 0 shows 'hp' but the model number is not legible.

claims.claim: Print speed black Normal: Up to 42 ppm
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be worn out.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and a photo of the printer's status page showing the remaining toner level.
risks.if_unproven: as having a used toner cartridge

risks.risk: The printer may have a mechanical or paper jam.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer ejecting a page or clearing a jam.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the model number and serial number on the printer.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge and the printer's status page.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
